correctness.rationale: For the μ_n plane action of coordinate weights (1,2), the polar form uses the INTEGER polarization, giving H_n=2I−S−S^{-1}−S²−S^{-2}+S³+S^{-3}. Multiplication by S³ gives f(S), f=(t−1)²(t+1)²(t²−t+1); each root of unity in the n-cycle shift eigenspectrum occurs once, proving nullities 1,2,4 in the stated odd/even/non-six/six cases. The integral quotient Z[t]/(t^n−1,f) uses monic degree-six f, so the six-dimensional companion C carries the full integral cokernel, not merely rational information. D=C⁶−I has D²=0, rank 2 and first/second determinantal divisors 1 and 3. Therefore C^{6k}−I=kD and the Smith factors k and 3k plus four zeros hold for ALL k≥1. Independently checked exact matrices, ranks, minors for several k and nullities for n=3..24. The bounded checks supplement the identities, not an infinite extrapolation.
